title: Count Apples and Oranges
summary: Total apples and oranges across all boxes, where a box whose chest reference is set also contributes its chest's fruit.
inputFormat: Boxes(box_id, chest_id, apple_count, orange_count) with nullable chest_id; Chests(chest_id, apple_count, orange_count).
outputFormat: A single row with total apple_count and orange_count.
edgeRules: A box with NULL chest_id contributes only its own fruit.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: box apples 1 oranges 2 with chest apples 3 oranges 4; box with no chest apples 5 oranges 0 -> apples 9, oranges 6.
